faq.q: What is the origin of Doszhan?
faq.a: Doszhan is associated with Kazakh. Doszhan is Kazakh, from дос ('friend') + жан ('soul'), meaning 'friend-soul'.
No — the underlying form is Kazakh, not Arabic.
Doszhan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Kazakh-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.

faq.a: Romanization variants include Doszhan, doszhan. Script forms are دوسجان, دُوسْجَان, दोसज़ान.
